note: 每行 = 一个可复用动作预设。status: ready=可直接用 / needs-work=先改成确定性 / skip=不入管线。layer: camera|media|layer|element|overlay

presets.name: 逐字上浮
presets.use: 标题、一句话强调；字数 ≤ 14
presets.avoid: 长段落（超过 20 字会拖尾）

presets.name: 模糊聚焦
presets.use: 副标题、解释性文字；有照片底时更明显
presets.avoid: 全片连用；低端机渲染成本高

presets.name: 折页落字
presets.use: 标题、引句；垂直节奏强的版面
presets.avoid: 小字号（< 40px 看不出折叠）

presets.name: 描边写字
presets.use: 关键词强调；一句里只做一个词
presets.avoid: 整段描边；细字重描边会糊

presets.name: 打字机
presets.use: 代码、命令行、对话式文案
presets.avoid: 超过 30 字；同屏再叠加入场

presets.name: 数字递增
presets.use: 数据、金额、百分比；必须有语义
presets.avoid: 无意义装饰数字；同一屏两个以上

presets.name: 字符乱码收敛
presets.use: 科技感标题；与代码/数据主题匹配
presets.avoid: 中文大标题；正式商务口播

presets.name: 解密揭示
presets.use: 关键词、代号、版本号

presets.name: 翻牌落字
presets.use: 短词、价格、倒计时类信息
presets.avoid: 长句；每字 8 次翻转很吃帧

presets.name: 环形文字流
presets.use: 片头 2-3 秒；品牌名重复

presets.name: 回声拖影
presets.use: 速度感标题；配合推镜

presets.name: 聚光跟随
presets.use: 聚光点跟着走；暗底、人像特写

presets.name: 边缘受光
presets.use: 边缘受光：一层偏侧的暖光，暗底照片上用

presets.name: 跟随倾斜
presets.use: 跟随倾斜：给照片块一点 3D 角度，再落正
presets.avoid: 大角度（> 10° 会晕）；含字幕区域
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'rotationX': -{{rx}}, 'rotationY': -{{ry}}, 'transformPerspective': {{perspective}}},
  {'rotationX':0, 'rotationY':0, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'power2.out'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 照片包裹
presets.use: 给照片块加圆角 + 轻微落定；不新增图形
presets.avoid: 每屏都包；照片本身已满幅时
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'borderRadius':'0px', 'scale':1.03, 'overflow':'hidden'},
  {'borderRadius':'{{r}}px', 'scale':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'power2.out'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 擦除切换
presets.use: 同屏内容替换：一版换成另一版
presets.avoid: 跨场景（那是转场节点的事）
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {clipPath:'inset(100% 0% 0% 0%)'},
  {clipPath:'inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)', duration:{{dur}}, ease:'power3.inOut'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 半调网点
presets.use: 网点密度随位置变化；canvas 背景，由 bgkit 按 t 重绘
presets.avoid: 和照片满屏同时用（会互相抢）
presets.code: /* canvas 背景：由 H02SX 调 bgkit.bind/ draw，不展开 GSAP */

presets.name: 扫描线

presets.name: 光束

presets.code: /* canvas 背景：由 H02SX 调 bgkit.bind/ draw，不展开 GSAP */

presets.name: 浮尘

presets.code: /* canvas 背景：由 H02SX 调 bgkit.bind/ draw，不展开 GSAP */

presets.name: 渐变网格
presets.use: 四色光斑游走；canvas 背景，由 bgkit 按 t 重绘

presets.code: /* canvas 背景：由 H02SX 调 bgkit.bind/ draw，不展开 GSAP */

presets.name: 缓推
presets.use: 整屏缓推；照片、满屏图层、图块都行
presets.avoid: 纯色屏；单次推近超过 20% 会露边
presets.code: timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'scale':1}, {'scale':{{to}}, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'none'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 缓拉
presets.use: 开场收束、结尾释放
presets.avoid: 满屏照片拉太小会露出底色
presets.code: timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'scale':{{from}}}, {'scale':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'none'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 横移
presets.use: 左右取景，配合文字固定
presets.avoid: 移动幅度超过 6% 会露边
presets.code: timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'xPercent':{{from}}}, {'xPercent':{{to}}, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'sine.inOut'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 双层视差
presets.use: 前景和背景反向走；字层不动
presets.avoid: 两层位移比超过 1:4，会看出来是两张图
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'xPercent':{{a}}}, {'xPercent':{{b}}, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'none'}, {{at}});
timeline.fromTo('{{sel2}}', {'xPercent':{{a2}}}, {'xPercent':{{b2}}, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'none'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 呼吸
presets.use: 停留段保持画面微动；上限 3%
presets.avoid: 和 C01 同屏重复；超过 3% 会晕
presets.code: timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'scale':1}, {'scale':{{to}}, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'sine.inOut'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 逐字错位
presets.use: 大标题、短句；一眼看出是排出来的

presets.name: 遮罩揭示
presets.use: 标题从一边揭开；比淡入有方向
presets.avoid: clip 反向收时不要和离场叠加
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'clipPath':'inset(0% 100% 0% 0%)'},
  {'clipPath':'inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)', 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'power3.inOut'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 荧光笔
presets.use: 关键词被扫过；浅底专用
presets.avoid: 深色底（multiply 会看不见）；整句都刷

presets.name: 角标
presets.use: 杂志框，给画面一个边界
presets.avoid: 每屏都换颜色；压住正文

presets.name: 逐项离场
presets.use: 一切屏的收尾；切点前 0.35–0.5s 走完
presets.avoid: 和进入同一时刻（会互相打断）
presets.code: timeline.to('{{sel}}', {'opacity':0, 'y':-{{dist}}, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'power2.in', 'stagger':{{stagger}}}, {{at}});

presets.name: 反向飞出
presets.use: 横向切镜前的收尾
presets.avoid: 竖向版面里横向飞出会撞边
presets.code: timeline.to('{{sel}}', {'opacity':0, 'x':{{dist}}, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'power2.in', 'stagger':{{stagger}}}, {{at}});

presets.name: 超大字落版
presets.use: 标题字号 ≥ 140px 时用；落定的那一下就是重量
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'scale':{{from}}, 'yPercent':{{y}}, 'opacity':0, 'transformOrigin':'0% 100%'},
  {'scale':1, 'yPercent':0, 'opacity':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'power3.out'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 字距收紧
presets.use: 一行字的收束；配合超大字最明显
presets.avoid: 正文；em 单位不要换成 px
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'letterSpacing':'{{from}}', 'opacity':0},
  {'letterSpacing':'{{to}}', 'opacity':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'power3.out'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 手绘下划线
presets.use: 一个词被划上重点；比加粗自然
presets.avoid: 已经用了荧光笔的词；深底不换色会脏

presets.name: 手绘圈
presets.use: 圈住一个数字或短词

presets.name: 打字机
presets.use: 代码、命令行、对话；一行内讲完
presets.avoid: 超过 30 字；同屏再叠加入场

presets.name: 竖排
presets.use: 四到八个字的标题；竖屏天生适合
presets.avoid: 长句；标点会和字挤在一起

presets.name: 删除线
presets.use: 否定一个旧说法，再给新的
presets.avoid: 和 K07 同时用在同一行

presets.name: 描边字
presets.use: 大字先以线出现，再填实
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'webkitTextStroke':'{{w}}px currentColor', 'color':'transparent'},
  {'color':'{{color}}', 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'power2.out'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 进度填充
presets.use: 比例、完成度、加载
presets.avoid: 没有真实数值时（会变装饰）

presets.name: 勾选
presets.use: 清单项被确认
presets.avoid: 同一屏勾五个以上（会变成装饰）

presets.name: 输入
presets.use: 搜索框、表单、命令
presets.avoid: 长文本；和 K09 同屏

presets.name: 点击
presets.use: 按钮、卡片被按下；证明界面在运行

presets.name: 悬停高亮
presets.use: 指针停在某个选项上
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'scale':1, 'opacity':.72},
  {'scale':{{to}}, 'opacity':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'power2.out'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 卡片入场
presets.use: ui-card / ui-bento 这类块

presets.name: 数据行逐条
presets.use: ui-row / ui-masonry-item 这类列表
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'x':{{x}}, 'opacity':0},
  {'x':0, 'opacity':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'power2.out', 'stagger':{{stagger}}}, {{at}});

presets.name: 标签点亮
presets.use: ui-chip / ui-step 这类状态标签
presets.avoid: 和 S02 同时抢焦点
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'opacity':.28, 'scale':.94},
  {'opacity':{{to}}, 'scale':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'power2.out', 'stagger':{{stagger}}}, {{at}});

presets.name: 颗粒
presets.use: 所有暗场；让静止画面也有呼吸
presets.avoid: 浅底用 multiply（这个渲染器会出黑块）

presets.name: 扫描线
presets.use: 科技、监控、旧屏质感
presets.avoid: 正文可读性下降时减到 .3 以下

presets.name: 半调
presets.use: 印刷感、报纸感；压在照片上最像
presets.avoid: 大面积纯色底（会变成格子纸）

presets.name: 暗角
presets.use: 每一屏都能加；把注意力压回中心
presets.avoid: 和 M05 同时全开会闷

presets.name: 辉光
presets.use: 片头、片尾、关键结论

presets.name: 漏光
presets.use: 换镜、情绪转折；一次就够

presets.name: 网格线
presets.use: 工程感、参数感；压在深色照片上

presets.name: 点阵
presets.use: 网点底，比网格线轻

presets.name: 拉丝
presets.use: 金属、扫描、速度感

presets.name: 撑满一行
presets.use: 一行字要顶到栏宽；靠缩放不用改字号

presets.name: 左擦除
presets.use: 从左边揭开这一屏
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'clipPath':'inset(0% 100% 0% 0%)'},
  {'clipPath':'inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)', 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 右擦除
presets.use: 从右边揭开
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'clipPath':'inset(0% 0% 0% 100%)'},
  {'clipPath':'inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)', 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 上擦除
presets.use: 竖屏最常用：从上往下揭开
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'clipPath':'inset(0% 0% 100% 0%)'},
  {'clipPath':'inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)', 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 下擦除
presets.use: 从下往上揭开
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'clipPath':'inset(100% 0% 0% 0%)'},
  {'clipPath':'inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)', 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 光圈
presets.use: 从一个焦点散开；适合人物特写
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'clipPath':'circle(0% at 50% 46%)'},
  {'clipPath':'circle(85% at 50% 46%)', 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 翻页
presets.use: 纸面、版面的换页
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'rotationY':-88, 'transformOrigin':'0% 50%', 'transformPerspective':1200, 'opacity':0},
  {'rotationY':0, 'opacity':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 甩镜
presets.use: 加速切镜；配合运动模糊最像
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'xPercent':{{dist}}, 'skewX':6, 'opacity':0},
  {'xPercent':0, 'skewX':0, 'opacity':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 硬切
presets.use: 最干脆的一刀；节奏快时用
presets.code: timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'scale':1.015}, {'scale':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'none'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 柱状增长
presets.use: U13 柱状图：柱子从基线长上来
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'scaleY':0, 'opacity':.4},
  {'scaleY':1, 'opacity':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'power3.out', 'stagger':{{stagger}}}, {{at}});

presets.name: 路径绘制
presets.use: U14 折线、任何 SVG 线：从起点画到终点

presets.name: 时间轴点亮
presets.use: U20 时间轴、步骤条：节点依次亮
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'opacity':.35, 'x':-10},
  {'opacity':1, 'x':0, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'power2.out', 'stagger':{{stagger}}}, {{at}});

presets.name: 分割擦除
presets.use: 上下两半合拢；比单方向擦更有仪式感

presets.name: 闪白
presets.use: 重音、切点；一屏最多一次

presets.name: 错位切片
presets.use: 快速换版；有速度但不像甩镜那么猛
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'xPercent':{{dist}}, 'skewX':-7, 'opacity':0},
  {'xPercent':0, 'skewX':0, 'opacity':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 圆角展开
presets.use: 卡片、图块自己张开变成整屏
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'borderRadius':'42%', 'scale':.8, 'opacity':0},
  {'borderRadius':'0%', 'scale':1, 'opacity':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 逐条入场
presets.use: 组件内部的项目逐条出现：气泡 .b、价格卡 .p、表格行 tr、时间轴 .t
presets.avoid: 子项超过 8 个；和 UA01 同时用同一批元素
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}} {{child}}', {'opacity':0, 'y':{{y}}},
  {'opacity':1, 'y':0, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'power2.out', 'stagger':{{stagger}}}, {{at}});

presets.name: 展开
presets.use: 面板、列表、卡片展开；transform-origin 在顶边
presets.avoid: 高度依赖内容的块（会压扁字）
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'scaleY':0, 'transformOrigin':'50% 0%', 'opacity':.55},
  {'scaleY':1, 'opacity':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 选中
presets.use: 选项被选中、输入框被聚焦

presets.name: 切换
presets.use: 标签页下的指示条滑到新位置
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'scaleX':0, 'transformOrigin':'0% 50%'},
  {'scaleX':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 拖拽
presets.use: 卡片被拖动后归位；表现“可操作”
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'x':{{from}}, 'rotation':{{rot}}},
  {'x':0, 'rotation':0, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'power2.out'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 遮罩收走
presets.use: 这一屏被一条竖边收走；比淡出干净
presets.avoid: 和入场擦除用同一方向
presets.code: timeline.to('{{sel}}', {'clipPath':'inset(0% 0% 0% 100%)', 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 缩放退出
presets.use: 往画面深处退走
presets.code: timeline.to('{{sel}}', {'scale':.92, 'opacity':0, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 上抽离场
presets.use: 整屏往上抽走，像翻上一页
presets.avoid: 和 X03 逐项离场同时写
presets.code: timeline.to('{{sel}}', {'clipPath':'inset(0% 0% 100% 0%)', 'yPercent':-4, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 环形
presets.use: 同心圆纹，做仪表/雷达感
presets.avoid: 和 M07 网格线同屏

presets.name: 斜纹
presets.use: 45° 细斜纹，做印刷/网点感

presets.name: 光扫
presets.use: 一道高光横着扫过画面；片头片尾

presets.name: 长影
presets.use: 45° 斜向长影，做立体/印刷感

presets.name: 半调线
presets.use: 横向渐变网点，比 M03 更规整

presets.name: 纸纹B
presets.use: 纸面加细纤维；配纸底用

presets.name: 网点重
presets.use: 粗网点，报章印刷感

presets.name: 玻璃
presets.use: 一层冷雾，压住杂乱的底

presets.name: 波纹
presets.use: 水波/同心纹，做情绪段

presets.name: 边角压暗
presets.use: 只压四个角，中间不动

presets.name: 光晕
presets.use: 暖光晕，片头片尾

presets.name: 色带
presets.use: 横向色阶带，做复古/印刷

presets.name: 粗噪
presets.use: 比 M01 更粗的噪点，做胶片感

presets.name: 时钟擦除
presets.use: 像表针扫过一样揭开；开场重音
presets.avoid: 一屏两次；字多的屏会读到一半被挡

presets.name: 立方
presets.use: 从侧面转进来，有体积感
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'rotationY':-84, 'transformOrigin':'0% 50%', 'transformPerspective':1400, 'opacity':0.25},
  {'rotationY':0, 'opacity':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 交叉扭曲
presets.use: 错位切入，速度感强
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'xPercent':6, 'skewX':-9, 'scale':1.06, 'opacity':0},
  {'xPercent':0, 'skewX':0, 'scale':1, 'opacity':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 梦幻缩放
presets.use: 慢慢从远处浮上来，情绪段
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'scale':1.3, 'opacity':0, 'rotation':-1.2},
  {'scale':1, 'opacity':1, 'rotation':0, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 涟漪
presets.use: 从中心荡开，比 X15 光圈更慢更软
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'clipPath':'circle(0% at 50% 52%)', 'scale':1.06},
  {'clipPath':'circle(92% at 50% 52%)', 'scale':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 数字跳变
presets.use: 数值从旧值跳到新值，做对比

presets.name: 条形换值
presets.use: 柱状图数据刷新：柱子长到新高度

presets.name: 行新增
presets.use: 列表里多出一行；配 S04 勾选
presets.code:
timeline.fromTo('{{sel}}', {'scaleY':0, 'opacity':0, 'transformOrigin':'50% 0%'},
  {'scaleY':1, 'opacity':1, 'duration':{{dur}}, 'ease':'{{ease}}'}, {{at}});

presets.name: 状态翻转
presets.use: 标签从“跟进中”变成“已成交”
